articles.summary: Apple’s MagSafe wallet is likely the default option for most people looking to carry a driver’s license, a credit card, and a little cash on the back of their iPhone. articles.title: Claude can now delete your production voice agent from a chat window
articles.summary: Developers can now ask Claude to inspect a production voice agent, revise its system prompt, change the voice entirely, or estimate the cost of using a different language model without ever opening the ElevenLabs dashboard. Monday, ElevenLabs introduced the hosted MCP connector, allowing Claude read and write access to chat agents built with ElevenAgents. In addition to creating agents and comparing configurations, the connector can calculate expected LLM usage and cost before a change is applied. For example, a developer could ask Claude: “What would my checkout agent cost per conversation with Gemini 2.5 Flash instead of GPT-4o?” This type of question is even more important now that cheaper models alone don’t guarantee lower bills once agentic orchestration is involved.

Rather than spending its keynote talking about cameras, displays, or silicon, Google devoted much of its time to Gemini Intelligence and a growing suite of AI-powered features that promise to make everyday smartphone use easier. Google’s AI remains among the most polished in the industry, whether it’s summarising conversations, managing your calendar, improving voice dictation, or enhancing your photos. Unlike plenty of AI gimmicks, Google’s software often solves real problems.

articles.title: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
articles.summary: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI regularly publish reports on how people are using products like Claude and ChatGPT, but they only release the data they want us to see, AI researchers say.  “There is no independent source to corroborate it,” says Anka Reuel, a computer science PhD candidate at the Stanford Trustworthy AI Research (STAIR) Lab.  Reuel is co-lead of a new research project, called the AI Observatory, that aims to fill the gap. It’s a public platform that aggregated and analyzed real AI conversations with popular models like Claude and Gemini that were collected with users’ consent through seven existing datasets. The intent is to provide independent sources of information that can help researchers and policymakers assess how people are using generative AI. High

articles.summary: The AI industry’s boldest promise right now is that AI will soon improve itself, with almost no need for human oversight. LLMs can already write code, generate synthetic data for training, and optimize the computer chips they run on. articles.title: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%
articles.summary:
AI應用、資料中心與高科技製造持續增加用電需求，發展穩定的低碳電力成為國內推動能源轉型的重要課題，其中運用地熱發電是一個重要的低碳電力來源，位於新北市金山的四磺子坪及硫磺子兩座地熱發電廠近期導入5G AI-RAN專網、Edge AI、AIoT與生成式AI維運等技術。地熱電廠導入機器狗智慧巡檢、能源優化分析及生成式AI維運系統 ，巡檢效率提高逾20%，夏季發電效率提升5%以上，建立國內綠能發電智慧維運管理的應用案例。
這項計畫由台灣大哥大與將捷集團旗下結元能源開發合作推動，在國發會「AI+產業智慧共創實證計畫－AI服務大平台整合次世代通訊之生態共創服務計畫」支持之下進行，希望驗證AI結合5G通訊在綠能發電場域的應用成效，建立可複製的智慧能源維運模式。
